changelog: Enjoy a more compact and easier-to-read chat.
Keep the latest 30 messages, with new messages automatically brought into view.
See a confirmation when you connect to chat.
See Twitch emotes directly in chat, with optional animations in Settings.
Keep emotes at a consistent size, whether animated or still.
Fix an issue that could prevent app updates from downloading.
Add automatic and manual update checks.
Add version history and in-app update downloads.
Add French, English, and German translations.
Refresh the app icon and TV banner.
Remember chat visibility and add a default setting.
Add an optional blurred stream background.
Distribute a non-debuggable release APK signed with a dedicated key.
